blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — AirAsia Philippines is confident the worst is behind it when it comes to skyrocketing jet fuel prices, which have forced airlines — including itself — to trim their route networks. But Anna Victoria Lu, president and general manager of the Malaysia-based carrier’s local unit, conceded that it may be “tough” even to match last year’s passenger traffic, as travel demand has soured amid the Middle East war.
